title: Sustainable nutrient enhancement of edible mushrooms via boiling and gastrointestinal simulation
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00346F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Si Qin, Sunantha Ketnawa, Nattaya Konsue
This study examined how boiling and in vitro digestion affect the nutritional properties of seven mushrooms: V. volvacea, L. polychrous, L. squarrosulus, P. ostreatus, A. odoratus, L. edodes, and A. auricula-judae.
